definitions.explanation: Clothes worn for work, especially practical clothing for manual or outdoor work rather than a suit.

examples.japanese: {仕事着|しごとぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I change into my work clothes.

examples.japanese: {仕事着|しごとぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{汚|よご}れた→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。

⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、⟦{作業場|さぎょうば}→作業場：07878_sagyouba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{仕事着|しごとぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えて→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Every morning my father changes into his work clothes at the workshop before starting.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事着|しごとぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into work clothes
- {仕事着|しごとぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: still in one's work clothes

- ⟦{作業着|さぎょうぎ}→作業着：24135_sagyougi⟧, ⟦{作業服|さぎょうふく}→作業服：16786_sagyoufuku⟧: work overalls, work uniform — for factory and construction work
